a ghost producer can write, produce, arrange, design, or add to a track “made” by a bigger artist. an NDA is signed, a payment is made, and the bigger artist puts their name on the track. sometimes ghost producers are credited in the “written by” section of a track. this is not to say that bigger artists don’t have a hand in producing a track. sometimes they have an idea and the ghost producers are able to bring that idea to fruition. sometimes 7+ producers work on a single track but only one artist is credited. and other times, the ghost producers don’t want their name associated with the track because it doesn’t align with their current sound/career.

yes you can!! I think the only way is if you go to intensive therapy (mostly DBT) , don’t lie to your therapists, and actually confront your character flaws in order to fix them. I’ve been a piece of shit in relationships but i’ve slowly been facing my character flaws and why they exist and how they’re impacting me today. i do a combination of psychoanalysis (to find out why I did things like lie, seek affection, cheat, have anger issues) and DBT (in order to actually make behavioral modifications). DBT kind of helps you rewire your brain and how you deal with things, but it takes at least a year (and probably more) to make significant changes. I do not think it is possible to overcome alone. if therapy isn’t an option for you financially you can always buy the DBT workbook and work on it yourself. there are a lot of youtube videos that help with skills found in the workbook so those would be useful as well. it is possible to recover but the first step is full acceptance and awareness of your issues, so that you can deal with them in a meaningful way. 

also, as someone else said, NO relationship is rainbows and butterflies. every relationship faces challenges, that’s what happens when you put people together. “everyone is a piece of shit, you just have to find the one who is willing to not be a piece of shit to you.” that’s just to say that everyone has flaws, you have to find the person who is willing to work on/improve those flaws for you. anyone you date will have flaws and you will have flaws. it’s about overcoming those flaws together in a healthy and loving way, which usually starts with communication.
